name: dsh-env-probe
description: Zero-dependency DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: probes the local machine environment (OS / shells / runtimes / tools / disks / proxy) once, caches the report, and injects it into every session's system prompt. v1.4.0: /env-refresh injects its diff into the model context as a notice (notifyModel: steer|inject|off), diff-only refresh command, env_refresh/env_probe tools, configurable version-probe commands, optional injection, 24h TTL.
